name: Rachid Guerraoui
one_sentence_summary: Rachid Guerraoui leads EPFL's Distributed Computing Laboratory (DCL), pioneering research in Byzantine-resilient machine learning, distributed algorithms, AI-assisted protocol discovery, and concurrent computing.
matrix_summary: Guerraoui's lab just released a striking new paper, "The End of Consensus Research?" (arXiv, Oct 2026), reporting how AI agents were used to autonomously discover *A-greement*, a new geo-distributed consensus protocol that beats state-of-the-art by up to 33% on latency — with a Lean-based verification framework that also found previously unknown bugs in existing protocols. The lab also released the companion *KCensus* open-source Rust system and several new papers on backdoor mitigation in decentralized LLM fine-tuning and multi-agent security.
